sec-head.h2: What does an OpenAI API developer do?

p: An OpenAI API developer designs, builds, and integrates production-grade systems using OpenAI's models (GPT-4o, Assistants, embeddings, Whisper). This includes API orchestration, prompt engineering, function calling, streaming, rate-limit handling, and secure key management. A freelance OpenAI API developer delivers a working, integrated system connected to your existing stack, backed by a proven API integration track record.
